class.name: VoxelWorld
class.brief_description: Node for generating infinite voxel terrain with block interaction API.
class.description: VoxelWorld generates an infinite procedural voxel terrain similar to Minecraft. The terrain is generated at runtime using Perlin noise and consists of colored blocks. The world is divided into chunks (16x64x16 blocks each) that are loaded and unloaded dynamically based on the active camera's position and the configured [member chunk_load_radius]. Use [member block_registry] to customize block types, colors, and textures. If no registry is assigned, a default one is created with 10 built-in block types. The block interaction API ([method get_block_at], [method set_block_at], [method raycast_block]) allows GDScript to read, modify, and raycast against the voxel world.

method.name: get_block_at
method.description: Returns the block ID at the given world position. Returns 0 (Air) if the chunk is not loaded.

method.name: set_block_at
method.description: Sets the block at the given world position and rebuilds the chunk mesh. Emits [signal block_placed] or [signal block_broken] as appropriate.

method.name: get_block_name_at
method.description: Returns the name of the block at the given world position from the block registry.

method.name: world_to_block_pos
method.description: Converts a world position to a block grid position.

method.name: block_to_world_pos
method.description: Converts a block grid position to a world position (center of the block).

method.name: raycast_block
method.description: Performs a voxel raycast from [param origin] in [param direction]. Returns a Dictionary with keys "position" (Vector3), "normal" (Vector3), "block_id" (int), and "block_pos" (Vector3i) if a solid block is hit, or an empty Dictionary if nothing is hit.

method.name: request_chunks_around
method.description: Requests chunks in a square region around [param world_position]. If [param radius] is [code]-1[/code], [member chunk_load_radius] is used. This queues missing chunks without unloading camera-driven chunks outside the region.

method.name: get_chunk_region_load_status
method.description: Returns chunk readiness around [param world_position] with keys [code]total[/code], [code]loaded[/code], [code]pending[/code], [code]remaining[/code], [code]progress[/code], and [code]ready[/code]. Pending and finished-but-not-integrated chunks are not considered loaded.

method.name: is_chunk_region_loaded
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] when every chunk in the requested region around [param world_position] has been integrated into the scene tree.

method.name: advance_time
method.description: Advances [member day_night_time_of_day] by [param hours] (can be negative to rewind). Wraps around 0–24 automatically. Immediately updates sun, moon, ambient light, and fog.

method.name: is_daytime
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the current time is between 6:00 and 18:00.

method.name: is_nighttime
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the current time is before 6:00 or at/after 18:00.

method.name: get_day_factor
method.description: Returns a smooth factor (0.0–1.0) representing how "daytime" it currently is. 1.0 = full day (7:00–17:00), 0.0 = full night (19:00–5:00), with smooth transitions during sunrise and sunset.

method.name: create_world_save
method.description: Creates a persistent world save rooted at [param save_dir], initializes the world seed, and writes [code]metadata.cfg[/code]. If [param save_seed] is [code]-1[/code], a random seed is resolved and stored for deterministic reloads.

method.name: load_world_save
method.description: Loads save metadata from [param save_dir], applies the saved seed and world time, clears loaded chunks, and reloads chunks from saved chunk deltas when available.

method.name: save_world_state
method.description: Updates [code]metadata.cfg[/code] with the current world time, seed, [param player_state], and [param character_state], then flushes dirty saved chunks according to [param max_dirty_chunks]. Use [code]0[/code] to write metadata only, [code]-1[/code] to flush all dirty chunks, or a positive value to write a bounded number of chunks.

method.name: flush_world_save_dirty_chunks
method.description: Flushes up to [param max_chunks] dirty saved chunks to disk. Use [code]-1[/code] to flush all pending chunk writes.

method.name: get_world_save_dirty_chunk_count
method.description: Returns the number of dirty or queued saved chunks waiting to be written.

method.name: close_world_save
method.description: Saves pending world state and detaches the current persistent save.

method.name: is_world_save_loaded
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] when this VoxelWorld is attached to a persistent world save.

method.name: get_world_save_metadata
method.description: Returns the loaded save metadata, including display name, seed, world time, timestamps, player state, and character state.

method.name: get_world_save_player_state
method.description: Returns the player state loaded from or last written to the active world save.

members.member: The seed used for terrain generation. Set to [code]-1[/code] for a random seed each time the game runs, or to a specific positive integer for reproducible terrain.
The radius (in chunks) around the camera within which terrain chunks are loaded. Higher values show more terrain but use more memory and processing time. Valid range: 2 to 16.
The world-space size of each voxel block. Default is 1.0 (1 meter per block).
The Y-level at which water generates. Blocks below this level that are not solid terrain will be filled with water. Valid range: 0 to 63.
The block registry resource that defines block types, colors, and textures. If not set, a default registry with 10 built-in block types is created automatically.

The time of day (0.0–24.0) at which the game starts. Applied to [member day_night_time_of_day] when the scene enters the tree at runtime. Changing this in the editor does not affect the live preview — use [member day_night_time_of_day] to preview different times.

Current time of day in hours (0.0–24.0). 0/24 = midnight, 6 = sunrise, 12 = noon, 18 = sunset. Controls sun/moon rotation, ambient light color, and fog color when environment nodes are assigned via [member env_sun_path], [member env_moon_path], and [member env_environment_path]. Dragging the slider in the editor updates the scene in real-time for previewing. At runtime, this is overwritten by [member day_night_start_time] on startup and then advances automatically if [member day_night_auto_advance] is enabled.
Duration of one full day/night cycle in real seconds. Only used when [member day_night_auto_advance] is [code]true[/code]. Valid range: 10 to 3600 seconds.
If [code]true[/code], [member day_night_time_of_day] advances automatically each frame based on [member day_night_day_length]. Emits [signal time_of_day_changed] each frame.

Multiplier for the automatic time advancement speed. 1.0 = normal, 2.0 = double speed, 0.5 = half speed. Only affects time when [member day_night_auto_advance] is [code]true[/code]. Valid range: 0.0 to 100.0.
If [code]true[/code], distance fog is applied to the environment. Fog fades distant terrain to the sky color, matching the current time of day.
Fog end distance as a fraction of the total draw distance ([member chunk_load_radius] × chunk size × [member block_size]). Lower values make fog start earlier. Valid range: 0.3 to 1.0.
Path to a [DirectionalLight3D] node used as the sun. VoxelWorld will rotate it, and adjust its color and energy based on [member day_night_time_of_day].
Path to a [DirectionalLight3D] node used as the moon. Optional. VoxelWorld will rotate it opposite to the sun and set a cool blue-white color at night.
Path to a [WorldEnvironment] node. VoxelWorld will update its [Environment] resource's ambient light, fog color/density, and fog distance based on the time of day.

signal.name: block_placed
signal.description: Emitted when a block is placed via [method set_block_at].

signal.name: block_broken
signal.description: Emitted when a block is broken (set to Air) via [method set_block_at].

signal.name: time_of_day_changed
signal.description: Emitted when the time of day changes — either every frame when [member day_night_auto_advance] is [code]true[/code], or when [method set_time_of_day] / [method advance_time] is called.
